title: The Zodiac on Trial
lines: The Zodiac on Trial revisits astrology without asking the reader for easy belief.
It separates several different practices hidden under the single name astrology.

emotionalPlan.purpose: It separates several different practices hidden under the single name astrology.
voiceDirections: Calm, direct, and curious. Make the subject understandable for a first-time listener.
Warm, restrained invitation. Finish clearly and leave space to reflect.

objects.meaning: Expressive participant in an authored illustrative situation, not a historical portrait.
A symbolic birth chart is an object of inquiry, not a verified causal mechanism

visual.meaning: A birth chart is examined on an evidence bench; calendar exposures, a personalized mirror and a revisable protocol remain separate mechanisms. No astrological predictive claim is endorsed or mystical causal arrow drawn.
